data._comment: content/contentEncoding are supplied by job-launch input, e.g. the output of an upstream transform/rest step that produced the outbound payment file.

steps._comment: sftp upload falls back to the immediately preceding step's base64 output when its own data/input is empty, same convention azure_blob already uses. Each step only sees ctx.upstream_output from the ONE step directly before it -- there's no fan-out, so don't insert another step between encrypt-file and upload-file expecting both to read encrypt-file's output; add a separate audit-copy job if you need one, rather than branching within this run.
